parameters.question: Compare power vs. sample size tables (n per group from 20 to 100, two-sided t-test at alpha=0.05, using the pilot data's effect size). Power values must match within 0.1% relative absolute error; row order, column order, and header labels may differ.

Compare the sample size results tables from a two-sample t-test power analysis (80% power, alpha=0.05, two-sided, effect size from the pilot mean difference and pooled SD). The required sample size per group must match within +/-2. Column order and header labels may differ. Power-vs-sample-size values (n=20 to 100), if present, should agree approximately.
